messages:
nina: Quick sync — SigmaCloud asked about a co-sell announcement for our Satellite Connector Registry + LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters. They want marketplace listing + joint blog within the same window. Can we align timelines? @james @alex @maria

james: timeline?

nina: thinking: marketplace listing on 2026-04-15, joint blog + partner quotes on 2026-04-20. Is that feasible from eng + partner side? :calendar:

alex: dev update: adapters functionally ready but we need a tiny schema tweak to the registry manifest (compat/capabilities fields). If we get final spec by 2026-03-28 we can ship adapters and PR by 2026-04-05.

maria: partnerships note: SigmaCloud's internal PR kickoff is 2026-04-18. BuildForge (our SI) also wants a joint case study and a live demo during the co-sell period — they'll need perf numbers + a reproducible demo script. CC @samir for demo deck.

samir: demo script and perf deck are in progress. I can post a draft tomorrow. Need a canonical prompt set and two reference infra configs (small + large) to validate latency/cost.

nina: legal check — do we need MSA addendum or NDAs for co-marketing? @legal-bot

legal-bot: Heads up: for co-marketing we need a basic co-marketing MSA + SigmaCloud trademark guidelines. I'll escalate to legal for a fast review. Expect initial feedback in 48 hours.

james: ops / billing note: marketplace listing will require a billing SKU + pricing tier. Who owns that? @finance (or cc finance lead)

alex: also posting the registry manifest example we'll propose for the marketplace listing, so partners can validate adapters quickly:

```json
{
  "connector": "langchain-satellite-v1",
  "compat": ["langchain>=0.1.0", "llamaindex>=0.5.0"],
  "capabilities": ["embeddings", "chat", "tool-calls"],
  "hardware_optimized": ["sigma-rtx-a100"],
  "version": "2026-04-01"
}
```

maria: orchestration note: OrchX (our orchestrator partner) requires an adapter to surface routing policies (cost vs latency) to their UI. Who can own that adapter?

nina: Samir, can you take OrchX adapter ownership? We should also define a canary rollout policy in Console for partner bundles (/rollout docs).

samir: I can own OrchX adapter. I'll open a GH PR and a sandbox playbook by 2026-03-30. Will include canary commands for Console.

james: any engineering blockers?

alex: one remaining blocker: acceptance tests for LlamaIndex index loaders — small test harness left. Should be 1-2 days of work.

maria: marketing/comm plan — I'll coordinate the announcements calendar with Marketing. Need a comms lead to draft copy + partner interviews.

nina: assigning Loretta as comms lead for the joint blog/social posts. Loretta?

loretta: on it. I'll draft the announcement timeline, social snippets, and partner quote requests. Will share a first draft by EOD Friday.

deploy-bot: deployment note: staging build scheduled at 2067890200, prod release window reserved at 2067891600.

nina: thanks — summarizing action items: Alex -> manifest PR + acceptance tests, Samir -> OrchX adapter + sandbox playbook, Loretta -> comm plan + draft, Legal -> MSA + trademark check, Maria -> partner PR coordination + BuildForge case study ask. We'll do a short sync Tuesday to confirm blockers. :thumbsup:
